font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: A relative is reached when it shares at least 10× more k-mers with the anchor than an organism from another kingdom does, and at least 100 sampled k-mers.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Number in each cell: how many times more; 1 in 200 (DNA: 1 in 1000) k-mers sampled.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Where the other-kingdom species share no sampled k-mer, the cell gives how many the relative shares instead.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: DNA k=36 spans the same 12 codons as protein k=12; dayhoff k=20 and hp k=52 match protein k=12 in bits (about 52 per k-mer).

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Only proteomes at least 90% complete by UniProt BUSCO; left out: Mytilus coruscus, Mytilus edulis, Solemya velum.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Protein, dayhoff and hp from UniProt reference proteomes; DNA from the coding sequences of the same genes.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: dayhoff letters: AGPST C DENQ FWY HKR ILMV; hp letters: AFGILMPVWY (hydrophobic), CDEHKNQRST (polar).

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Each column is one main rank, the same in every panel. Each relative sits under the lowest main rank it shares with the anchor.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: These also share a sub-rank, so they are closer than that rank alone: Mus caroli (subgenus), Rattus norvegicus (subfamily), Danio rerio (subphylum).

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Conclusion: compared with protein, no reduced alphabet reaches a farther rank for any anchor. Every other row stops at the same rank as protein.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: reached: passes, and so does every rank nearer the anchor

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: another kingdom: the background, 1× by definition

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: no relative at this rank in the species set
